cards.audioText: What preparations should a flight crew make before taking off at night from the runway shown?
cards.audioTextZh: 从图中所示跑道夜间起飞前，飞行机组应做哪些准备？
cards.referenceText: Before the night takeoff, I would brief the threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would delay or reject the takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 夜间起飞前，我会对相关威胁进行简令，检查飞机系统和性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会推迟起飞或中断起飞。

cards.audioText: What hazards should pilots consider when taking off at night from the runway shown?
cards.audioTextZh: 从图中所示跑道夜间起飞时，飞行员应考虑哪些危险？
cards.referenceText: At night, reduced visibility makes it harder to judge height, distance, terrain, and clouds. Spatial disorientation and higher cockpit workload can make the takeoff and departure more demanding. A thorough briefing and a careful instrument cross-check help control these risks.
cards.referenceTextZh: 夜间能见度较低，更难判断高度、距离、地形和云层。空间定向障碍和较高的驾驶舱工作负荷会使起飞和离场更具挑战。充分的简令和谨慎的仪表交叉检查有助于控制这些风险。

cards.audioText: What types of runway lighting help pilots during takeoff and landing at night?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些类型的跑道灯光可以在夜间起飞和着陆时帮助飞行员？
cards.referenceText: Approach lights and runway-end identifier lights help pilots find and align with the runway. Threshold, edge, centerline, and touchdown-zone lights show the runway's position and usable landing area. Runway-end lights and visual glide-slope indicators provide additional guidance during landing, while edge and centerline lights also support takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近灯和跑道入口识别灯帮助飞行员找到跑道并与跑道对正。入口灯、边灯、中线灯和接地区灯显示跑道位置及可用着陆区域。跑道末端灯和目视下滑指示器在着陆时提供进一步引导，而边灯和中线灯也为起飞提供支持。
